question: Why are practices like breath control described as to be abandoned here?
premises: Breath control and similar practices are described as to be abandoned in this context.
They do not function as a means to supreme knowledge.
What is not a means to the highest knowledge is set aside at this level.
inference: Practices such as breath control are rejected here because they do not serve as means to supreme knowledge.
